subject: what the sponsor side adds
body:
The same corpus answers the other direction. A sponsor page carries its placement history month by month, the publications it runs in, the sponsors that share inventory with it, and lookalike publications ranked by audience, cadence and topic.

For a signal stream that matters because it turns a mention into a market: an account appearing in a list that a competitor pays for is a different event from an account appearing anywhere.

Both sides are on the same API, so a record can carry the publication, the sponsor and the date together. I can send a sample with the fields joined that way.
